propositions: Multiple bundles for one S3 ref render the store unclonable and push-stalled because git-remote-s3 rejects writes while bundles>1 and fetch cannot resolve the ambiguous ref, causing retries to never converge.

Upstream git-remote-s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only (blocking input() on EOF) and discards the non-chosen head's unique events without merging, causing unacceptable data loss in an append-only event store.

The heal must perform crash-safe S3 object operations (write merged tip before deleting originals) by delegating to git-remote-s3's own S3Remote/.s3 client and acquire_lock/release_lock, routing all S3 access through a single thin adapter with no direct boto3 dependency in core rebar.

The heal must losslessly merge N divergent bundle heads via iterated 2-parent merges following sync._union_merge semantics (UUID event dirs never collide, .bridge_state/* uses merge=ours), never using merge=union or octopus merge, so every unique commit from every head remains reachable.
On genuine content conflict in a non-derived file, the heal must abort without deleting any remote bundle, release locks, and surface fsck-recover without discarding the conflicting parent.

Push.py must detect both multi-bundle signatures (helper reject and ambiguous fetch) and invoke heal_multi_bundle exactly once per push call (healed_once guard) to avoid retry thrashing; concurrent doctors serialize via the helper's per-ref lock and back off if another holds it.
